additional_context: Alex is our first child. He started walking at 15 months. He has very few words - maybe 3 or 4 that he uses inconsistently. He's a sweet boy but seems to be in his own world a lot. He really loves spinning things and can watch the washing machine for a long time. Grandma mentioned that he seems different from other kids his age, which is why we're doing this screening.

1_point_follow.detail: He usually looks at my hand or finger instead of where I'm pointing. It's like he doesn't understand what pointing means.

2_deaf_concern.detail: Actually, yes. We've wondered about that. He often doesn't respond when we call his name, especially if he's focused on something.

3_pretend_play.detail: No, not really. He likes lining up his cars in rows and spinning their wheels, but he doesn't pretend to drive them or make car sounds.

4_climbing.detail: He's not very interested in climbing. He seems a bit cautious about physical activities.

5_finger_movements.detail: Yes, he does this thing where he wiggles his fingers in front of his eyes, especially when he's excited or looking at lights.

6_point_request.detail: No, he doesn't really point. He usually takes my hand and leads me to what he wants, or just cries until we figure it out.

7_point_share.detail: No, he doesn't point to show us things. He doesn't seem interested in sharing experiences like that.

8_interest_children.detail: Not really. At the playground, he ignores other children. He's more interested in the fence or the sandbox than the other kids.

9_showing_objects.detail: No, he doesn't bring things to show us. He plays by himself and doesn't try to involve us.

10_response_name.detail: Rarely. We have to call his name many times or go to him physically. Sometimes we wonder if he even knows his name.

11_social_smile.detail: Not consistently. Sometimes he smiles, but often when we smile at him, he looks away or doesn't react.

12_noise_sensitivity.detail: Yes, definitely. He covers his ears and screams when the vacuum is on, or if there's a loud unexpected noise.

13_walking.detail: Yes, he walks. He started at 15 months.

14_eye_contact.detail: He doesn't make much eye contact. When I try to look into his eyes, he often looks past me or turns away.

15_imitation.detail: No, he doesn't copy us. When I wave or clap, he doesn't try to do it back.

16_gaze_follow.detail: No, he doesn't follow my gaze. He doesn't seem to notice what I'm looking at.

17_attention_seeking.detail: No, he doesn't really try to get our attention. He's content playing alone and doesn't check to see if we're watching.

18_understanding.detail: He doesn't seem to understand much of what we say. We can't give him simple instructions without showing him what to do.

19_social_referencing.detail: No, he doesn't look to us when something new happens. He just reacts on his own or ignores it.

20_movement_activities.detail: He doesn't like being swung or bounced. He gets upset and stiffens up when we try.
